provenance.source: FDIC quarterly call-report panel via the Undertow run (free public data; https://banks.data.fdic.gov)
provenance.method: cross-sectional screen of every FDIC-insured bank each quarter from public call-report data; the signal set, its weights and the scoring rule are withheld; labels = genuine receiverships only

watchlist_semantics: the US flag is a BUDGETED WATCHLIST: a fixed share of the industry is flagged every quarter by construction, and the rule that decides which banks fall inside that budget is withheld. A flag is a screening rank, not an institution-level verdict. The false-positive story is the published scoreboard: the realized base and flagged rates and the lift over the base failure rate are all served, and no cherry-picked healthy controls are shown, on purpose.

recent_misses.note: Named failures without a flag in the preceding 24-month availability window. A missed signal does not establish the cause of failure. Current amended filings are not validated as-published history.

recent_failures.name: Community Bank And Trust - West Georgia

historical_evidence.availability_time_basis: report period plus conservative filing proxy
historical_evidence.reason: FDIC history is the current amended vintage and the committed packs do not preserve every originally published bank-quarter revision
